about: The preflight window settings. scripts/send_window.py reads this file. The message check thresholds are in rules.json, which is shared with campaign-qa and scenario-qa. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.window_days: Default length of the preflight window, in days from now.
notes.edited_days: A live event-triggered flow edited within this many days is fetched and checked; older ones are listed by name only.
